title: Module 1: Professional Portfolio Architecture
overview: Established a responsive personal website using Flask and Jinja2, focusing on a clean UI/UX for technical presentations.
learned: I implemented a dynamic templating system to separate content from presentation, a core principle in scalable software design.

title: Module 2: High-Volume Web Scraping
overview: Built a high-concurrency browser automation scraper using Playwright to collect 30,000+ records from The Grad Cafe.
learned: I mastered asynchronous execution and bypassed advanced anti-bot mitigation strategies to ensure data scale and integrity.

title: Module 3: Relational Database Design
overview: Designed and queried normalized SQL databases to handle complex relational datasets and analytical reporting.
learned: I learned to write optimized JOIN queries and manage schema constraints to maintain data consistency in multi-user systems.

title: Module 4: Software Assurance & Testing
overview: Implemented a comprehensive test suite using Pytest, achieving 100% branch coverage across core modules.
learned: I adopted a test-driven development (TDD) mindset, using markers and coverage reports to quantify software reliability.

title: Module 5: Documentation & Software Standards
overview: Developed automated documentation pipelines and adhered to PEP 8 standards using Pylint and Sphinx.
learned: I realized that code is read more often than it is written, making standardized docstrings and automated documentation essential.

title: Module 6: Dockerized Microservices
overview: Architected a multi-container environment with PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and Python workers using Docker Compose.
learned: I mastered container orchestration and learned to solve deployment race conditions in distributed systems.

title: Module 7: AWS Cloud Integration
overview: Integrated Python applications with AWS S3 using Boto3, focusing on secure IAM credential management.
learned: I learned the security implications of cloud storage and how to manage object-based data programmatically.

title: Module 8: Data Engineering Pipelines
overview: Built robust data cleaning pipelines in Pandas to handle outliers, missing values, and type conversions.
learned: I learned that data preparation is the most critical stage of the ML pipeline, requiring rigorous validation and outlier detection.

title: Module 9: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering
overview: Applied K-Means clustering to identify patterns in high-dimensional datasets, optimized via the Elbow Method.
learned: I deepened my understanding of hyperparameter tuning and the math behind inertia-based cluster optimization.

title: Module 10: Interactive Data Dashboards
overview: Created a responsive analytical dashboard using Plotly and Dash to visualize complex price-to-feature relationships.
learned: I learned to translate complex data findings into interactive visual narratives for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Module 11: Advanced Preprocessing
overview: Implemented specialized feature engineering techniques, including encoding, scaling, and dimensionality assessment.
learned: I gained experience in optimizing feature sets to improve model performance and reduce computational overhead.

title: Module 12: Neural Networks from Scratch
overview: Developed a two-layer neural network using only NumPy, implementing manual backpropagation and weight updates.
learned: Writing the backpropagation math manually solidified my understanding of how gradients flow through a network.

title: Module 13: Model Deployment & LLMs
overview: Deployed a real-time inference service for admissions prediction using Flask and modern PyTorch-based model weights.
learned: I learned the logistical pipeline required to move a model from a training notebook to a production-ready API.
